_comment_fa: راهنمای تنظیمات MCP Server برای استفاده همزمان از 21st.dev Magic و دیزاین سیستم UI/UX Pro Max
_comment_en: MCP Server configuration example to combine 21st.dev Magic components with UI/UX Pro Max design intelligence

usage_instructions.cursor: Copy the windows_example or macos_linux_example object into your project's .cursor/mcp.json or Cursor -> Settings -> MCP
usage_instructions.claude_desktop: Add the 21st-magic entry to your ~/.claude/claude_desktop_config.json under mcpServers
usage_instructions.windsurf: Add the 21st-magic entry to ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json under mcpServers
usage_instructions.synergy_protocol: AI models should use 21st-magic tools to search and fetch components from 21st.dev, then customize them using the styles, colors, and typography from ui-ux-pro-max in PROMPT.md
